comments.author: @xeroxyde69420
comments.text: The documentary was right up until it claimed that zouk was born in Martinique. It wasn't. Zouk was pioneered by Kassav', a band founded by Guadeloupean musicians and deeply rooted in Guadeloupean musical traditions, before later bringing in major Martinican members. Guadeloupe is Martinique's sister archipelago in the French West Indies.

comments.author: @delbertharry8915
comments.text: I wish the AI had learned to pronounce the cultural danses and places.  Fort-de-France is not the only place on Martinique to visit because you can go to Cap 110  pronounced (C-ah-p) 110 in French, Le Diamant and the beach there, Anse D'arlet, Savanne des Esclaves in Les Trois-Îlets, the ruins of Saint Pière, Le Prêcheur, and go to the east coast to Presqu'île de la Caravelle, and so much more.  The danse is Quadrille(kahdree), and Ti punche(the drink).  A wonderful part of the Créole speaking caribbean.  Tjimbé rèd pa moli.
